mentions.name: DriveLens
mentions.description: A privacy-friendly cloud storage manager for Google Drive and MS OneDrive, similar to WinDirStat. It analyzes storage using only file metadata via fully client-side browser API calls, with no file contents accessed.
mentions.source_excerpt:
A privacy friendly cloud storage manager like Windirstat for Google Drive & MS Onedrive

https://drivelens.click/

No file contents are accessed, only metadata, fully client-side API calls (browser to google API).
